trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unlock every other trophy and this one pops on its own. There is no online or DLC trophy, so one single-player run is all it takes. Expect the road to run about 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist for A Long Road. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission in Chapter 1. Just play the story and it pops. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It unlocks once you start Chapter 2 by completing its first main mission, 'What's in the Bag?'. Keep playing the campaign and it comes automatically. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'. No side work needed — just the campaign. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. Play through the story and it pops. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. It unlocks after the final main mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero'. Automatic — just finish the chapter. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The final-mission gold: it unlocks when you complete the last main mission of Chapter 5 and roll the credits. PowerPyx calls it the final mission; other lists word it as completing Chapter 5. Either way, it is automatic story progress. Source: PowerPyx; ofzenandcomputing.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the campaign — no extra step. Just play the mission when it appears. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks as you play the mission. Automatic, cannot be missed. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It unlocks during the campaign. No side content required. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It unlocks as you play through Chapter 4. Automatic story progress. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks during the campaign. Just play the mission. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks as you play the final chapter. Automatic, cannot be missed. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% completion gold, and the hardest trophy in the list. After the story, the checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: partial credit for 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations and 15 of 18 card sets, plus any 100 optional missions. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests are needed in full. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing toward 100% is missable. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida (100% needs 300). Four kinds count: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps by parachute. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots; each stunt has its own name and stays marked once done. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. The tracker sits under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. You will tick most of these off naturally while chasing other trophies; filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the rest. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every shooting-range challenge — 42 challenges across 12 ranges. PowerPyx has a dedicated guide to all 12 locations and 42 golds. Work through them range by range; the gold thresholds are per challenge, so repeat any you miss. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total). PowerPyx has a dedicated guide to all 14 locations. One win per venue is enough — you do not need to win every race. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations, so pick the ones you are comfortable with. Note it is 20 distinct races, not the same race 20 times. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 main mission 'Feng Shui (Meet Cal)', Cal texts you a fishing spot (purple map icon). Follow his fishing questline and out-fish him in his challenge. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any arcade game. Four are playable: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind (on the TV at home via the controllers, from Chapter 1), plus Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around the world. 'Complete' means finishing all of a game's levels at least once — you do not need every challenge. Pick the one you like best. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's final mission, Lucia only. In Chapter 3, playing as Lucia, Andy calls and then texts his home address in Belville. Finish his 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Everything stays available after the story. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's final mission. After the Chapter 1 main mission 'Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)' he calls you; find him at the green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at shipwrecks — purple chest icons on the map; use the metal detector to dig them from the ocean floor and bring them back. Clear 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton vanishes for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (playing as Jason, call Brian to speed it up). Track under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's final mission. His questline opens after the Chapter 2 main mission 'Coffee Break', at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All still available after the story. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count as strangers. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries); PowerPyx notes more are still being found. All strands stay open after the story in free-roam. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's final mission and his 16-car wish list. It opens after the Chapter 3 main mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS', where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars he wants to his garage (green 'RK' icon, west Vice City) — scan high-end cars with WAiNK (hold Up) to check if one is on the list. Cars show up most in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Track under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's final mission, Jason only. After the Chapter 3 main mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty', purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go and destroy them ('Take Out Kitty Litter'). Once enough labs are down, Tyrone hands you his second quest, 'Spin On This' (shut down the labs), which unlocks the trophy. Still available after the story. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida (10 locations, both Jason and Lucia, so each spot counts twice). Track under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, can only be done then — after the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. PowerPyx is unsure whether that first meditation is required for the trophy, so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. The last meditation needs both characters together (after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break'). Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. After the Chapter 2 main mission 'Coffee Break', playing as Jason, Bret texts you — meet him in Lummox County for 'Veteran Hunted' (Lucia cannot receive it; Jason only). He then marks hunting spots with purple icons; bring him the animals he asks for. His first quest hands you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69'. Track under Map > Activities > Target Deck — all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets and 480 cards in total; 100% needs 15 sets. PowerPyx has a dedicated guide to all 18 set locations. Three sets is the trophy; keep collecting toward 15 for A Long Road. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold Up + R1 to scan objects in the world — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. There are more than 100 in total; PowerPyx breaks them down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags. Any 100 count. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. 100% needs any 70, so this pops on the way. There are 10 more challenges than needed, so pick the easiest. View them under Progress > Challenges (a 'Completed' checkmark shows bottom-right). Many finish naturally while working on other trophies — save this for one of your last trophies. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Earliest after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break' — call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), cause carnage to 4 stars, then escape in a fast sports motorcycle; shoot down any helicopter chasing you. Easiest: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle on train tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — large bank vault robberies always give 4 stars. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner without losing your wanted level. Only after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break' (character switching). Hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while staying chased — keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. Call your partner (hold Right + Triangle). The unlock is delayed — it pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop; if it does not, hit a 4th. Good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'). Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch. Open WAiNK on your phone (hold Up), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic. 100% needs 200 base-model vehicles, so this comes automatically. Check under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming: time slows and weak spots light up. It drains the purple focus bar and lasts only a few seconds, so buff focus first (food and drinks, washing up at home; consume Adrenaline — hold L1, press Triangle — to extend it). Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them fast without missing; an assault rifle like the Duke 556 beats pistols and SMGs for this. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Raise your Focus level via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — it must be connected to a passenger boarding bridge; planes on the airfield do not work. Easiest: the plane at terminals E3/E4. Drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight to it; stairs by the boarding bridge lead into the plane (or enter on foot through the terminal). Go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane back to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km away from the airport. The unlock is slightly delayed. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — 'kinda hot in these Rhinos.' Find them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; the tanks stand in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies (green icons). Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun — do NOT kick the door, which trips the alarm. In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. Good location: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)' — an introduction to bank vault robberies; you do the first one in the mission. Tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry the briefcase in and open the vault, then go in quickly and rob it. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). Afterwards, pay Yasmani (the fence from Chapter 3) for security-van tips ($10,000, purple icon) after doing his earlier quests. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to go unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs total; this trophy needs any 5, but 100% needs all 8. Up to $205,000 per bank — the best endgame money. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — the same mission that opens bank vault robberies: robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Tail the truck to the bank, follow the guard's cash into the vault, steal it and escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray. All 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100%, so this comes automatically. Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape. Sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. Fastest with a plane: fly over every fogged area until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx has a dedicated guide: 'How to Unfog the Map Fast (Best Plane)'. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; this trophy needs 1 per gang, but 100% needs all 39, so it comes automatically. They show as yellow icons when you go near them; many are marked automatically from story progress. Track under Progress > Gangs — scroll over a gang to see how many of its operations you robbed. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar and the trophy unlocks. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue 'Banshee' from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the window. You can only steal it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs'. Hack into the car, drive forward through the glass — the unlock is slightly delayed (it pops after you drive further down the street). Only the blue Banshee works — an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a gang operation in Port Gellhorn. Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first (needed to blow the safe). You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling' (marked automatically). Inside, grab the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item — killing the enemies is not necessary. If you miss one during the mission, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for the rest; it is not missable and does not need all 3 in one visit. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > 'Strength' (heart icon). Only after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break' (character switching). Raise strength by working out — buy a gym membership (filter Map > Activities, dumbbell icon; many across Vice City; also work out at home after the story). Always go together (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner): while you actively train with one character, the other finishes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — whenever you do something affecting reputation you see a little demon face on the right of the screen. Profiles: Professional (stealthy objectives and robberies, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) — and Irredeemable, a permanent status from excessive violence: avoid it, cops shoot on sight more. This comes naturally while working on all other trophies; if it is still missing at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no written guide has a method yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown (it guessed the Payday Loans store from the Prologue). New lead: gameplay footage (Facebook Reel, FlipKing Gaming, 19 Nov 2026) shows Lucia in an orange prison jumpsuit being escorted into an office, where she meets a woman named Stephanie at a desk; Stephanie asks 'Do you know why you're here?' and Lucia answers 'Bad luck, I guess' — the trophy's name. So this is almost certainly a story trophy from Lucia's prison scene meeting Stephanie, not the Payday Loans store — but it is not yet confirmed by a written guide, so treat it as a story moment and keep playing. Source: PowerPyx; FlipKing Gaming footage.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, go solo. It is slightly random, not a guaranteed spawn: at the roadside you will sometimes find a blinking car; if it is there you can trigger the UFO, if not drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her and offer to help; she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside — do that and the trophy unlocks. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx still lists this trophy as currently unknown (it believes it is from kicking people while driving a motorcycle). The description reads 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by', and other sources agree on the core: knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle (ofzenandcomputing: 'take out a target with a melee drive-by'; GTA Six Insider: 'knock over bowling pins with a melee drive-by'). Try melee attacks from a moving vehicle — most likely kicking from a motorcycle — but no guide has confirmed the exact method yet. Source: PowerPyx; ofzenandcomputing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)' — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not at once. This comes naturally while doing all robberies for the 100% checklist. Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery within a few minutes, but those only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…'. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buying guns, car mods and tattoos is fastest (most expensive). Shop counts from PowerPyx: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios, 15 electronics stores. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story-related garages; this trophy needs only the 8 buyable ones). They cost $160,000 total. Garages open after the Chapter 2 main mission 'Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)' — you get a notification that a new app was installed on your phone, 'Vice City Real Estate'. Buy them through the phone app. A quick way to make the money is robberies, especially in Chapters 3-4 when higher-value robberies unlock. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission 'Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)'. It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you. You must buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes — each garage adds parking spots). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click 'Respray' and 'Register'. Initially he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money — keep expenses low by using cheap low-end cars and bikes. Source: PowerPyx.
